# BarBend

> > BarBend is the official USA Weightlifting media partner providing expert training guides, equipment reviews, and news coverage for strength sports including powerlifting, CrossFit, bodybuilding, and Olympic weightlifting.

Founded as a comprehensive strength training resource, BarBend publishes multiple newsletters including the BarBend Newsletter (by Ricky Goodrich), The Ripped Report (bodybuilding-focused), and Morning Chalk Up (CrossFit coverage). The site features expert-reviewed workout programs, exercise tutorials, equipment testing, and breaking news from major competitions like the CrossFit Games and CrossFit Open.

- [Training | BarBend](https://barbend.com/training): Training section covering strength training and weightlifting techniques

## Newsletters

- [BarBend Newsletter](https://newsletter.barbend.com): Free strength training newsletter by BarBend with tips in 3-min read

- [The Ripped Report](https://therippedreport.barbend.com): Bodybuilding newsletter by BarBend with muscle-building workout guides
